title: A surprise for Ivetta
story:
After our Geovisual Analytics exercise, we stayed behind to surprise Ivetta for her 27th birthday. Kylie had planned the surprise and set the scene with balloons, a birthday banner, and party blowers. Aundrea prepared the cake, and we all gathered around as Ivetta blew out the candles.

Tina couldn’t find a number 7 candle, so she used a 3 and a 4 instead. With all three candles lined up, it looked like Ivetta was turning 234. A little weird, sure. But we can do the math. 3 + 4 = 7. There we go. 

Happy 27th, Ivetta!
